item.title: Mexican national accused of voting in Marion County 2022, 2024 general elections
item.description: A Mexican national is accused of illegally voting in multiple elections in Marion County.Homero Ramos, 51, is charged with violating Alabama law and is facing five years in prison.Acting U.S. Attorney Catherine L. Crosby said Ramos is a lawful permanent resident but that he has never obtained U.S. citizenship.
